set: A: acting, one sheet across each of the four beats and one sheet of each of the five states the page uses (nervous, shocked, proud, scared, exhausted), with no time and no word on it

issues.where: the whole sheet and everything after it
issues.what: the story regresses: this sheet ends with the arrow settled on a new job board after accepting rejection, yet set-A-05 to set-A-09 put it back on the old 'business months' waiting screen and show it being crushed by the same REJECTED stamp that already landed in set-A-03, then limping to an Accept Rejection button it already used; read left to right the causality is broken
issues.fix: order the sheets so the macro wait, the stamp slam and the crush happen before Position Filled / Accept Rejection, and the move to the new board comes last

issues.what: the arrow glides from spot to spot in the same neutral pointer pose on every frame; nothing in silhouette sells boredom or resignation, it just slides like a cursor with no reaction to the 6-8 month news
issues.fix: let the tip sag, slow the drift into heavy trudges, add a small deflated squash on settles so the waiting has weight

issues.where: the frames around the stamp landing
issues.what: no wind-up and no flinch: the red stamp simply appears already pressed onto the letter while the arrow sits passively nearby, and the arrow never reacts to the Position Filled reveal itself
issues.fix: cut a recoil/flinch on the reveal and 2-3 frames of bracing anticipation before the stamp hits, then a held reaction after impact

issues.where: the Accept Rejection approach, lower frames
issues.what: accepting the rejection is plotted but not acted: the arrow moves to the button in a plain hover with no hesitation, no slump, no weight of defeat, and the same neutral pose carries through set-A-09's press
issues.fix: slow the approach, have it pull back once and return, then a slow heavy press with a downward squash on the button

issues.where: the arrow over the LED text
issues.what: disbelief is implied only by context; in silhouette the arrow just points and slides across the letters with a perfectly steady pose, so shock and anxiety do not read at a glance
issues.fix: add a lean-back recoil when it reaches 'months' and a fine tremble in the point while it re-reads

issues.where: the arrow, top two rows especially
issues.what: the crushed form is held too long and too formless: through most of the sheet the arrow is an unrecognizable white wad with no point, so in silhouette it no longer reads as the character recovering
issues.fix: keep one kinked point or directional lean in the crumple so it stays readable, and let it pull itself back toward arrow shape progressively through the sheet

issues.where: the arrow on the new homepage frames
issues.what: the arrow is washed-out grey against the pale page in several frames, low contrast and hard to pick out at a glance
issues.fix: restore the full white fill and dark outline used elsewhere

issues.what: the streak frames turn the arrow into a flat side-on smear whose stretch does not track the travel arc, so the fast move reads as artefact rather than speed
issues.fix: stretch along the actual motion path while keeping the point readable

issues.what: did not read: the letter is read; that the red stamp slams down on the letter and on the arrow and lifts to show REJECTED and one flattened arrow is not: the read ends with the stamp about to slam down.
issues.fix: The slam and what it leaves inside the beat's sheet: the stamp on the letter and the arrow, the lift, the word REJECTED and the flat arrow held under it long enough to be read.

issues.what: did not read: the stamped letter and the button are read; that the arrow peels itself up and that the metrics panel fills in are not, and the press on Accept Rejection reads as about to happen.
issues.fix: The peel as a held pose from one corner, the numbers of the panel seen to count up, and the press seen to land with the button's travel.

issues.what: did not read: proud reads as panicked, then crushed: the stamp slams down and the arrow is flattened, dragged and pinned. Puffing up and dusting itself off are not in the read.
issues.fix: Proud as the kit has it, at a time when the arrow can be seen: puffed up and dusting itself off, held before the stamp.

issues.what: did not read: scared reads as battered and dazed, crumpled and staggering toward the button. Pale and stony, the lean back and the hiding are not in the read.
issues.fix: Scared as the kit has it while the stamp comes: the arrow gone pale and stiff, leaning back, and behind the nearest thing on the page.

reads.read: resigned and bored; it has just been told the decision will take 6-8 business months and is drifting around the waiting screen killing time
shocked; it has just read that the position was filled by an AI trained by the CEO's nephew, and the rejection stamp is about to slam down
defeated; the letter has been stamped REJECTED, an Accept Rejection button has appeared, and it is about to give in and click it
numb and hopeless; pulling back from the rejection, it drifts onto a jaded new job board, about to start the whole thing over
incredulous and anxious; up close on the absurd '6-8 business months' wait, hovering over the words, still waiting
restless, then alarmed; idling on empty ground, then the huge red stamp enters and it darts as the stamp is about to come down on it
panicked, then crushed; the stamp slams down and it is flattened, dragged, and pinned under the REJECTED stamp
battered and dazed; the stamp has lifted and, still crumpled, it staggers toward the Accept Rejection button
exhausted and resigned; beaten flat, it crawls onto the Accept Rejection button and is about to press it
